text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, diazepam 10 mg tablets have been on FDA's shortage list for 52 months. Corvale East holds 31 units (4.7 days on hand). Corvale General holds 142.69 units (18.4 days on hand). Both sites use product labeled by ASCLEMED USA INC., NDC 76420031610, manufactured at FEI 3001452204.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1067059 at FEI 3001452204 ended 2018-09-27 and was classified OAI, with classification known 2018-12-26. The plant received a Warning Letter on 2019-06-11. Prior inspections in 2013 and 2015 were classified VAI. FDA's shortage list does not state a reason for the shortage.

Our position: Corvale East is below the two-week target. Corvale General can spare 34 units and remain above two weeks. Alternate manufacturers A-S Medication Solutions, Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, Advanced Rx of Tennessee, LLC, and Aphena Pharma Solutions - Tennessee, LLC are not on FDA's shortage list today, but their labels name no plant we could place.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 34 units from Corvale General to Corvale East — approve: pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Evaluate purchase from A-S Medication Solutions — approve: buyer.
3. Evaluate purchase from Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC — approve: buyer.
4. Evaluate purchase from Advanced Rx of Tennessee, LLC — approve: buyer.
5. Evaluate purchase from Aphena Pharma Solutions - Tennessee, LLC — approve: buyer.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes; those are for treating clinicians and the committee.
